planned_method_boundaries.conducted: Independent oscillators, shielded/cabled path, calibrated declared reference plane, measured uncertainty, wanted/noise/blocker sweeps, and overload checks.
planned_method_boundaries.channel_emulator: Independent emulator normalization mapped to sample SNR, Es/N0, Eb/N0, SIR, tap power/delay, and Doppler before paired analysis.
planned_method_boundaries.ota: Only explicitly authorized facilities/scenarios; record geometry, antenna configuration, motion, environment, firmware, calibration, and authorization boundary.
planned_method_boundaries.partitioning: Independent physical capture session; adjacent slices from one recording cannot cross partitions.
planned_method_boundaries.statistics: Session-clustered confidence intervals; zero observed events receive bounds rather than zero-risk claims.

prohibited_inferences: Commanded generator level is not measured receiver-input power without a calibrated chain and uncertainty.
Synthetic IQ is not recorded-IQ or HIL evidence.
Infrastructure readiness is not validation success.
No regulatory, certification, interoperability, product, or production-RF claim is supported.
